docs: Clean-room composition. Idea only, no license (Phil Pitus, Generative UI #6). The story does not fetch or merge. The flow scene steps through create, fail, fix, and merge with invented Taller Ladrillo data. The checks pill stays closed on the open step. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button or any of the four pieces already installed. No theme.
